diffs.diff: pin count: part has 2 (WIND GND), datasheet reading has 4 (RJ11 pin 1 RJ11 pin 2 RJ11 pin 3 RJ11 pin 4)
diffs.evidence: The datasheet says 'The anemometer switch is connected to the inner two conductors of the RJ 11 cable shared by the anemometer and wind vane(pins 2 and 3)', so the anemometer itself has only two leads (the part's WIND = pin 2, GND = pin 3), while RJ11 pins 1 and 4 belong to the wind vane, which the second reading itself marks as nc/not required.

diffs.diff: wind speed km/h per Hz of switch closures: datasheet reading gives 2.4 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: The datasheet states 'A wind speed of 2.4km/h causes the switch to close once per second', and the part already uses exactly that scale (driver KMH_PER_HZ = 2.4, sim pulse hzPerUnit = 1/2.4 = 0.41667, example test 30 km/h = 12.5 closures/s); the gate sees none only because the pulse-sensor model stores it as hzPerUnit rather than a conversion field.
